components.name: Enter Control
components.description: The circular invitation that begins the scroll-controlled property journey.
components.css: .ds-enter { width: 7.2rem; height: 7.2rem; border: 1px solid var(--brass, #c79749); border-radius: 50%; color: #f3c778; background: rgba(4, 11, 8, 0.16); font: 700 0.68rem/1.5 "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, "Century Gothic", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 220ms ease-out, background 220ms ease-out, transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-enter:hover { color: #07110d; background: #d6a553; transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-enter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8dd5e4; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-enter:active { transform: scale(1); }

components.name: Solid Commercial Action
components.description: The primary dark action used on mineral-paper commercial sections.
components.css: .ds-action-solid { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.85rem 1.35rem; border: 1px solid #142019; border-radius: 999px; color: #eee9df; background: #142019; font: 700 0.68rem/1.5 "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, "Century Gothic", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-action-solid:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-action-solid:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8dd5e4; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-action-solid:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Commercial Action
components.description: The supporting paper-section action with a botanical hairline.
components.css: .ds-action-outline { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.85rem 1.35rem; border: 1px solid #142019; border-radius: 999px; color: #142019; background: transparent; font: 700 0.68rem/1.5 "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, "Century Gothic", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 200ms ease-out; } .ds-action-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-action-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8dd5e4; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-action-outline:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Enquiry Field
components.description: A transparent, square field whose single underline preserves the quiet dark close.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.7rem; color: #eee9df; } .ds-field span { font: 700 0.66rem/1.5 "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, "Century Gothic", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 0.8rem 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245, 240, 229, 0.42); border-radius: 0; color: #eee9df; background: transparent; font: 400 1rem/1.5 "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, "Century Gothic", sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #91a096; } .ds-field input:hover { border-bottom-color: rgba(245, 240, 229, 0.7); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-bottom-color: #8dd5e4; outline: 2px solid #8dd5e4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Flight Navigation
components.description: A transparent top rail that frames the photograph with quiet uppercase links.
components.html: Cinematic FlightProperty websites in motionSelected workThe offerContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 2rem; padding: 1.6rem clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 4.5rem); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245, 240, 229, 0.16); color: #f5f0e5; background: #07110d; font: 600 0.7rem/1.5 "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, "Century Gothic", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-wordmark { display: grid; gap: 0.32rem; line-height: 1; } .ds-wordmark strong { font-size: 0.7rem; } .ds-wordmark small { color: rgba(245, 240, 229, 0.72); font-size: 0.56rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: none; } .ds-nav span { display: flex; gap: clamp(1.1rem, 3vw, 3.25rem); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration-color: transparent; text-underline-offset: 0.35rem; transition: text-decoration-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-nav a:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8dd5e4; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Seven-Node Flight Progress
components.description: The lower-edge orientation system for the seven-scene property journey.
components.css: .ds-progress { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 1.25rem; min-width: 28rem; color: rgba(245, 240, 229, 0.88); background: #07110d; font: 600 0.64rem/1.5 "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, "Century Gothic", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-progress-track { position: relative; height: 1rem; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; } .ds-progress-track::before, .ds-progress-track i { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: calc(50% - 0.5px); height: 1px; } .ds-progress-track::before { width: 100%; background: rgba(245, 240, 229, 0.32); } .ds-progress-track i { z-index: 1; width: 33.333%; background: #c79749; } .ds-progress-track b { position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; border: 1px solid rgba(245, 240, 229, 0.78); border-radius: 50%; background: #102019; }

components.name: Proof Frame
components.description: A borderless 4:5 property photograph with a quiet brass sequence caption.
components.css: .ds-proof { width: 15rem; margin: 0; color: #d0a25b; background: #07110d; } .ds-proof div { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #102019, #58654d 52%, #c79749); filter: saturate(0.82); transition: filter 320ms ease-out, transform 500ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-proof figcaption { padding-top: 0.85rem; font: 400 0.64rem/1.5 "Avenir Next", Avenir, Futura, "Century Gothic", sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.18em; } .ds-proof:hover div { filter: saturate(1); transform: translateY(-0.5rem); } .ds-proof:focus-within div { outline: 2px solid #8dd5e4; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Cinematic Flight is an editorial property world that behaves like an arrival rather than a conventional agency page. Native-width photography occupies the full viewport first, then yields to motion only as the visitor scrolls. Monumental Bodoni Moda, forest-black exposure, thin brass signals, and quiet utility labels make the interface feel cinematic, architectural, and controlled.

The commercial story arrives on warm mineral paper after the experience has earned attention. Explanatory sections stay restrained and spacious; the dark enquiry close returns the visitor to the opening atmosphere without pretending that the prototype form is a live service.
keyCharacteristics: Scroll-scrubbed motion that grows out of a sharp still-image anchor.
Monumental, tightly set Bodoni Moda paired with tracked Avenir/Futura utility text.
Forest, paper, botanical ink, and rare brass accents.
Hairline structures, wide breathing room, and deliberately sparse copy.
A warm-paper commercial handoff followed by a dark, quiet enquiry close.

rules.name: The Brass Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Brass marks entry, orientation, numbering, or provenance; it does not become a broad decorative fill.

rules.name: The Two Atmospheres Rule
rules.body: Use forest-dark surfaces for experience and enquiry, and mineral-paper surfaces for explanation. Do not muddy either world with generic mid-gray panels.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda expresses the property and proposition; the sans-serif stack gives instructions and metadata. Do not swap their jobs.

rules.name: The Short Measure Rule
rules.body: Display statements remain compact and architectural; supporting prose stays near the observed 38rem maximum instead of stretching across the viewport.

rules.name: The Horizon Stays Clear Rule
rules.body: The photographic hero remains full-bleed and uncluttered. Interface elements occupy disciplined edges and corners rather than becoming a central overlay card.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Material Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by image, tone, hairline, or motion—not by generic drop shadows.

rules.name: The Reserved Curve Rule
rules.body: Use circles for journey controls and pills for direct actions; do not round sections, photographs, proof frames, or fields.

dos: Do let verified property photography establish the atmosphere before service copy appears.
Do preserve the sharp native-width opening anchor and fade responsive motion in only after scroll begins.
Do keep the seven-node progress, vertical rail, and property signature as one coherent journey-orientation system.
Do use warm paper for commercial clarity and forest-dark surfaces for immersion and the enquiry close.
Do maintain visible keyboard focus, the skip link, the reduced-motion static opening, and responsive behavior down to 320px.
Do keep proof and method sections restrained enough that the property remains the evidence.
donts: Don't replace the opening with a generic agency hero, feature-card grid, or interface panel over the photograph.
Don't use placeholder or synthetic property imagery where verified photographs exist.
Don't overuse brass, pure white, rounded cards, gradients unrelated to photographic legibility, or drop shadows.
Don't autoplay a time-based film in place of visitor-controlled scroll movement.
Don't invent pricing, testimonials, availability, booking actions, performance claims, or production form behavior.
Don't let motion become mandatory; reduced-motion visitors receive the static photographic opening.
